card.name: First piece of a drug name in lists
card.fires_on: The first letters of a drug name that comes right after a comma or "and" in a list of interacting drugs, such as the start of oxcarbazepine, rufinamide, omeprazole or tenofovir. Also the colon after "Anticonvulsants".
